decisions.story_title: Review finds Dutch prosecution service lacked monitoring before 2025 Citrix zero-day hack
decisions.reason: Desnips snip verified against the primary NOS/Nieuwsuur article (published Oct 8, 2026): investigation for the Dutch justice ministry found the Openbaar Ministerie had no network monitoring for years before the 2025 hack; attackers used a Citrix zero-day from May/June 2025, logged in successfully on 20 June 2025, installed a backdoor, and kept access about a month; the OM went offline for weeks and 9,000 court cases were delayed; sources say Deloitte saw characteristics of a Chinese state actor.

provenance.evidence: NOS/Nieuwsuur: OM had no monitoring system; Citrix zero-day abused from May/June 2025, backdoor installed, 9,000 court cases delayed; Deloitte reportedly saw Chinese state-actor characteristics.
